sources.snippet: ABSTRACT Bivariate Pareto distributions have proven very useful in modeling lifetime data, hydrology, competing risk data, and many other datasets. In this paper, we explore Kendall tau and Gini correlations in the bivariate Pareto distributions, comparing with the popular Pearson correlation and robust quadrant correlation. sources.title: Estimators of the correlation coefficient in the bivariate exponential distribution
sources.snippet: A finite-support constraint on the parameter space is used to derive a lower bound on the error of an estimator of the correlation coefficient in the bivariate exponential distribution. The bound is then exploited to examine optimality of three estimators, each being a nonlinear function of moments of exponential or Rayleigh observables.
